Sofia Santos, a payments change approver and not the author Mara Costa, gave a code_review approval on the head commit 32b73be4a0d894f0aa6d6501040e74ce4ed5ba34.

summary: The change raises only the payments standard-session idle timeout from 30 to 45 minutes in policy.py and the matching approved parameter. Privileged idle remains 15, and the other product-obligation symbols in those files are unchanged, so those obligations are outside this change. The ticket is approved and scoped to both components, an independent change approver and an out-of-team control owner approved the head commit, and CI shows the payments suite passing on that commit. No security-sensitive component, emergency deployment, product deviation, or lapse of prior evidence is present.
